profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer I at SocialTables/Cvent, and I recently graduated from the University of North Carolina Chapel Hill with a degree in Computer Science. I am interested in how software can optimize peoples' everyday lives and improve quality of life in every aspect.

positions.locationName: Tysons Corner, Virginia, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Software Engineer I at SocialTables (now part of Cvent)

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description: Retail sales of Apple products including personal computers, accessories, and tablets as well as household appliances.  Exceeded sales goals for first time associates.

positions.title: Accounting Intern
positions.description: As an intern in the Cross Company Accounting Department, I worked a full-time, 40-hour schedule over 1 summer. I reviewed Accounts Payable invoice documents to correct import & processing errors as well as organized balance sheets from an acquired company to integrate into Cross Company’s balance sheets. I also approved company expense reports and initiated automated Accounts Payable processing for acquired company vendor invoices

positions.title: Industrial Service Technician's Apprentice
positions.description: At J.A. King and Company, I worked a full-time job and accumulated over 800 hours of experience over 2 summers as an Industrial Service Technician's Apprentice. I assisted and trained in calibration and repair of industrial scale systems as well as provided repairs and calibrations in both lab environments and in customer manufacturing environments. I also interacted directly with customers on a daily basis informing them of hardware problems and job statuses.
